title: The repro run's settings and limits are stated where the repo keeps its results
goal: kb/_self/reports/research-repro.md (or the repro rows of benchmarks.csv) states the run's --settings value with the gitkraken and caveman plugins off, effort high, --max-turns 200, --area-usd 8 and --instance-usd 58, so a reader of the repository can check the run against its gates without the untracked _cache/bench-repro/run.json. Found by the SP-ccvfvoqj review (S3).

run: import sys;t=open('kb/_self/reports/research-repro.md',encoding='utf-8').read();L=t.splitlines();need=['enabledPlugins','caveman@caveman','--max-turns 200','--area-usd 8','--instance-usd 58'];m=[w for w in need if w not in t];print(m);sys.exit(1 if m else 0)
